title: Academic Journey & Machine Learning Career Path
description: Interview discussing my academic journey from mechanical engineering at Koç University to computational science at Imperial College London, research experiences in biomedical engineering and micro-robotics, and transition to machine learning engineering. Also covers advice on university life, building relationships with professors, and career decisions between academia and industry.

title: Machine Learning Applications in Healthcare: A Comprehensive Review
description: Published article exploring the current state and future potential of machine learning applications in healthcare, covering diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, and personalized medicine.

title: Building Scalable Data Pipelines for Biomedical Research
description: Podcast episode exploring best practices for designing and implementing robust data infrastructure in biomedical research environments.

title: Ethical Considerations in AI-Driven Healthcare
description: Conference presentation examining the ethical implications of implementing AI systems in healthcare, including bias, privacy, and accountability concerns.

title: Featured in TechCrunch: Young Innovators in Healthcare AI
description: Featured article highlighting my work in applying machine learning to healthcare challenges and the journey from academic research to industry innovation.

title: The Future of Personalized Medicine Through AI
description: Opinion piece discussing how artificial intelligence is revolutionizing personalized medicine, from genomic analysis to treatment optimization. Published in leading healthcare technology magazine.
